slices.focus: Tasha launches structured volunteer recruitment with role cards, attendance expectations, and backup call tree
slices.summary: Tasha moves from supporting volunteer coordination on the side to leading a full recruitment and training cycle. She pushes outreach through church bulletins and a caregiver newsletter, holds a Saturday information session at the hospice campus, and builds structured materials: role cards (clear task boundaries), written attendance expectations, and a backup call tree for group nights. The agent helps her develop a screening rubric (tolerance for structure, comfort with limits, consistency of availability, practical vs. abstract answers), frame the training around 'reliability as a form of care,' and put attendance expectations in the first training email rather than saving them for a corrective moment. Tasha plans to draft the rubric and send the first training email the following week.
